predictions: A third consecutive week with 18 correct picks means last week tied for my third best week of the season so far. And of my seven wrong, four of them (two 12-12s, a 13-11, and a 13-10) could have flipped my way on a single dart. All of that brings my total for the season to 117-56 (67.6% correct), which is pretty decent when you consider that I am an embarrassingly tragic 8-12 in C division, and 13-15 in G division. The biggest news of last week though? I got picks right with both the Niners AND The Dartifacts… my first(!) correct one for either team.

Match of the week: (C Div.) The Outlaws @ Village Idiots. The C division battle was flat out cruising toward this pairing as a monster head-to-head for the #1 slot. And then last week, Sanchez took the Idiots out behind the woodshed with a big old switch (which seems pretty cruel if the Idiots really are idiots). So now this matchup is still big, but isn't this week's version of the match of the century. And let's be honest… the Idiots lose exactly 50% of their games. Outlaws, 15-9.

Match #2: (B Div.) Kilts In The Hall @ Hump Day! Darty Minds is making the B race a one-horse race. But the race for 2nd behind them is quite a battle, with five teams separated by only two matches. And here are two of the top three of that group, in what might well eliminate the loser from any chance of a title prayer. I'll take Humpers, 13-11.

Matches #3 & #4: (A Div.) Talladega Flights @ Show Me Your Tips; Dart Attack @ Why So Serious? The first half of the season separated A into a top-two, a middle-four, and a bottom-one. That middle four group is separated by only a single match, and here the two 3-3s take on the two 2-4s. Will Talladega and Attack and shove the other pair far behind them, or will Show and Serious knot this foursome up even further? I'm guessing a little separation is coming… Talladega gets a touch of payback in a 13-11 win; and Attack gets Serious again, 15-9.

Matches #5, #6, #7 and #8: (G Div.) Triple Shot @ The Dartifacts; Heart of Dartness @ Bright side of Flights; We're Sexy & We Throw It @ I Got Your 6; Dart Knights @ 21 Dart Salute. Ok, it has come to this… literally EVERY G division match feels like it could be critical in the season race. In G world, even the last place teams put together win streaks (Bright Side one dart from running three straight) and they take out division leaders (Triple Shot over Knights just last week). In G world, nothing means a loss is imminent like reaching the lead duo (see: damn near any week of the season). What does all this mean? It means this race is GLORIOUS. Every team within three wins (and some points) of first. Meaning every team within three losses (and some points) of last. And NO match is a lock, at all, ever. But we'll guess for this week anyway… Dartifacts get by Triple Shot, 14-10. Dartness handles Bright side, 15-9. I Get Your 6 gets by your Throw It, 14-10. And the Knights salute Salute, 15-9.

Match #9: (B Div.) Raging Bulls Eyes @ Shooter McGavin. With the way the B division standings have shaken out so far, this looks to be a potential early winner-stays-in-the-division-and-loser-drops matchup. But Raging has won more than 49% of their sets this season. How are they even in this position? I'll take Raging, 14-10.

Match #10: (D Div.) Red-eye Rangers @ Dart Side of the Moon; Liquor Possee @ Menace 2 Sobriety. Four D teams sit in the middle of the division at either 4-3 or 3-4, all waiting to see if the 2nd half of the season is a charge at the leaders or a fight to avoid a drop to E. Here, the 4-3s each face a 3-4. Will these bring clarity? Well, both yes and no… Rangers take it, 14-10; but Menace climbs up, 13-11.

Match #12: (E Div.) Death Throw @ Rippin Darts. There is quite a pack of 4-3 and 3-4 teams in E trying to reel in the Corks for 2nd in E. Here are the top two of those. I'm guessing DT gets 1001 revenge.
